name: State machine analyzer
blurb: A completeness check for a state machine. Write each state and what its events do, and see which pairs nobody decided, which states can't be reached or left, and where two rules disagree.

inputs.label: Machine
inputs.description: A state is a line ending in a colon, with its rules beneath it: event -> next state, or stay, defer, reject, ignore or back. Text after # is the reason. The guide below has the rest.

input.machine:
# The dinner booking as first drawn: the happy path and its obvious branches.
gather:
  slots_complete -> search
  slots_missing  -> stay
search:
  slot_free -> confirm
  none_free -> gather
confirm:
  user_yes -> book
  user_no  -> gather
book:
  committed -> stay
  unknown   -> stay
  refused   -> gather
  paid      -> notify
notify:
  sent        -> done
  send_failed -> report
report:
  told -> done
degraded:

# Events the code can observe that no rule uses yet.
events: user_revises, slot_gone, model_unavailable, model_back

# The dinner booking, every cell decided. The first part is the drawing.
gather:
  slots_complete -> search
  slots_missing  -> stay
search:
  slot_free -> confirm
  none_free -> gather
confirm:
  user_yes -> book
  user_no  -> gather
book:
  committed -> stay
  unknown   -> stay
  refused   -> gather
  paid      -> notify
notify:
  sent        -> done
  send_failed -> report
report:
  told -> done

# Everything below is a decision the drawing didn't make.
gather, search, confirm:
  user_revises -> gather     # nothing is committed yet, so start again
every state except gather, search, confirm:
  user_revises -> defer      # a booking or a text exists; finish, then revise
gather, search:
  slot_gone -> stay          # no slot chosen yet; the next search covers it
confirm:
  slot_gone -> search        # the slot on offer is gone; search before asking
book, degraded:
  slot_gone -> defer         # what the booking, or the state resumed, says decides
notify, report:
  slot_gone -> report        # a booking that existed is gone; tell the user
gather, notify:
  model_unavailable -> degraded   # these states need the model
degraded:
  model_back -> back         # return to the state it left
  told       -> stay         # the user knows; keep waiting for the model

every state:
  committed -> report        # a reservation this state didn't make is real; report it
  paid      -> report        # a payment this state didn't make is real money; report it
  sent      -> report        # a text went out; it can't be recalled
  model_unavailable -> stay  # this state runs as code
  model_back -> stay         # nothing was waiting for the model
  anything else -> reject    # a result this state never asked for: log it, do nothing

# Two people edited this one.
idle:
  start -> running
running:
  pause -> paused
  stop  -> idle
paused:
  resume -> running
  stop   -> reject    # resume first, then stop

# Added later, by someone else.
paused:
  stop -> idle        # stopping is always allowed
every state:
  archive -> archived

# A card payment driven by webhooks. They can arrive twice, late, or out of order.
pending:
  payment.processing      -> processing
  payment.action_required -> needs_action
  payment.succeeded       -> paid
  payment.failed          -> failed
processing:
  payment.succeeded -> paid
  payment.failed    -> failed
needs_action:
  payment.processing -> processing
  payment.failed     -> failed
paid:
  payment.succeeded -> ignore   # the same webhook, delivered again
  charge.refunded   -> refunded
failed:
  payment.action_required -> needs_action   # the customer tries another card
every state except paid:
  charge.refunded -> reject     # nothing was charged, so nothing to refund
